edits.why: Tokens come from maude-v2. The v2 component sheet loads last, so the shared controls take the v2 look. The old sheet stays only as a bridge for .panel and .tree-row, which v2 doesn't have.
The canvas header names its design system. It should match the meta.

In maude-v2, --presence-agent is the spark, which marks the AI and nothing else. MK is a person, so the avatar moves to another presence hue. Without this edit it would turn vermilion and read as the AI.

notes: Every var(--…) token in this canvas also exists in maude-v2. Only --presence-agent changes, for the reason above.
Classes that v2 doesn't have, used here: .panel (lines 72, 170, 286, 303) and .tree-row (243–247).
The theme stays forced to dark on each artboard wrapper (lines 324–339).
The fold-back CTA is a filled accent button. In maude-v2 that is azure, which fits 'azure acts.'
The prose in the header comment (lines 11–13) and the comment in the sibling RepoBranchSwitcher.css still name the maude DS. Both are text only.
